inlines.v: PENITEN'TIAL, adjective Proceeding from or expressing penitence or contrition of heart; as penitential sorrow or tears. PENITEN'TIAL, noun Among the Romanists, a book containing the rules which relate to penance and the reconciliation of penitents.
